quests.title: Moonlight Sonata: Lingering Resonance

dialogue.t: Ah, you're here? The kuuhenki are playing the lyre again. Could you play a song for them like last time?
And I happen to be in the mood to hear something different myself.

dialogue.sit: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...
Let's try the one Columbina always sings...
(But what tone should I go for...)

dialogue.t: That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.
Hehe, only 'cause you're such a great singer! Whenever we hear your voice, sometimes we stop for a bit just to listen...
Hm, the kuuhenki seemed quite enraptured with your performance as well. Perhaps they picked up a few things...
I might require your educational assistance again in the future.
Come, give me your hand.
Huh? No, no, this was a free performance. No tuition fee required!
Hmm? Tuition fee?
I only thought... the gentle glow of moonlight would make a fitting accompaniment for such a beautiful melody.
That was lovely. So you really did memorize my tune.
Hehe, only 'cause you're such a great singer! Whenever we hear your voice, sometimes we stop for a bit just to listen...
Hm, the kuuhenki seemed quite enraptured with your performance as well. Perhaps they picked up a few things...
I might require your educational assistance again in the future.
Come, give me your hand.
Huh? No, no, this was a free performance. No tuition fee required!
Hmm? Tuition fee?
I only thought... the gentle glow of moonlight would make a fitting accompaniment for such a beautiful melody.
Oh, it's over already? I could listen to that forever...
As I once told you, this is the only lullaby I can remember.
Although I have yet to discern the meaning behind it, after hearing you play, I feel like whatever answer is waiting for me, up there on the moon... at the very least, it must be a beautiful one.
Here, give me your hand.
It's okay. Seriously, you don't need to give us anything in return.
Ah, that wasn't my intention... I only wished to adorn your melody with a ray of gentle moonlight.

dialogue.sit: Let's try something from another nation...
Let's try something from another nation...

dialogue.t: How curious... I have heard melodies like this before, but your playing lends a whole new dimension...
Ah, maybe because {NICKNAME} was channeling his(her) emotional connection to that place...
What's curious is that... I feel as if I can picture the landscape just by listening to the melody. I wonder how the real thing compares to my imagination...
You should just go see it someday! We can be your tour guides!
Mm... Perhaps. If that day ever comes.

quests.description: The Damselette seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall…
